title: 2.6.2: Key Equations
originalText:
Key Equations

            slope-intercept form of a line	
            \(f(x)=mx+b\)	

            slope	
            \(m=\frac{change in output (rise)}{change in input (run)}=\frac{Δy}{Δx}=\frac{{y}_{2}−{y}_{1}}{{x}_{2}−{x}_{1}}\)	

            point-slope form of a line	
            \(y−{y}_{1}=m(x−{x}_{1})\)
